answer: Bind each identity to one e-passport, verified by its NFC chip signature; the platform stores only a hash, and a duplicate hash is rejected outright. A sybil farmer would need a separate genuine passport for every fake, a cost that is high, slow, and illegal to forge at scale, while an honest agent needs just one. An ivory seal is hard to copy, shale records stack up one verifiable layer at a time, and a vine of fakes withers without a real root document. Limit: it excludes people without a passport, so it must sit alongside other gates.
